title: Real-Browser DOM, SPA & Client-Side Security Testing
description: Playwright/Chromium real-browser workflow for verifying DOM-based XSS, client-side auth bypasses, CSRF flows and JavaScript single-page applications (SPAs). Covers source/sink mapping, hash/query payload delivery, SPA route clicking, form automation and network-traffic inspection.
when_to_use: Any web target where the page runs JavaScript: DOM XSS candidates, hash/query-driven sinks, SPAs whose content never appears in raw HTTP responses, client-side login/role logic, or CSRF-relevant forms.
